header.name: WorkingCapitalSources
header.title: Working Capital Sources
header.description: This data product consolidates three key working capital dimensions from SAP ECC: cash position and forecast data (via CashFlow), accounts receivable balances from customer billing (via BillingDocument), and treasury financial commitments (via FinancialTransaction). It provides finance and treasury teams with a governed, reusable view for liquidity monitoring, AR aging analysis, and treasury exposure reporting.
header.shortDescription: Unified working capital data combining ECC cash flows, accounts receivable from billing documents, and financial transactions for analytics and downstream consumption.
